units: Core implementation states CTC Omega->Delta mathcal G and defines minimal primitives for constraints, revision, mechanism space and CTC-enabled vs closed adaptation.
Dataclass stores source, information dict and strength; docstring treats it as extracted environmental structure Omega, not raw sensory data.
Dataclass holds list of mechanism strings; expand appends unique string and returns no explicit value; size() returns list length.
rules dict; revise(None) sets internal_update=True, revise(constraint) records environment_update=constraint.source.
permeability_active switch, RevisionMechanism and AdaptiveMechanismSpace implement CTC OFF/ON branches.
If permeability active, passes constraint to revision and generates mechanism; otherwise invokes internal-only revision without mechanism generation.
Placeholder deterministically generates mechanism string adapt_to_<constraint.source> and adds it if unique.
Dataclass requires controller and stores state/representation; observe updates representation from signal information; adapt delegates to controller.apply_constraint and has no explicit return.
Proxy returns 1.0 if permeability_active else 0.0; docstring says future versions should estimate derivative or Omega->Delta mathcal G.
Environment module defines E_t world state and extracts Omega_t constraint information for CTC simulation.
Dataclass requires task and rules, with difficulty default 1.0 and timestep default 0.
Dataclass requires state:EnvironmentState and maintains history; step appends current state reference then increments state.timestep.
Returns task, difficulty and rules from current state.
Creates ConstraintSignal with source=current task, information containing rules/difficulty and strength 1.0.
Static methods mutate a rule, increase difficulty or replace task.
Factories create simple navigation, rule-shift strategy-game and open-problem environments; open-ended factory is marked future-expansion placeholder.
Metric layer intends to turn Omega->Delta mathcal G and E* rightsquigarrow C_rev into permeability, mechanism expansion, adaptation velocity, residual capability and dependency quantities.
Dataclass stores metric name, numeric value and interpretation string.
Returns 1.0 iff agent.controller.permeability_active else 0.0; interpretation equates active switch with reality influencing adaptive mechanisms.
Computes after.size()-before.size(); positive delta interpreted as adaptive mechanism-space expansion.
Computes after_removal/before_removal, rejecting zero baseline; any positive residual interpreted as capability survived removal.
Computes external/(external+independent); >.5 labeled high dependency, otherwise low; zero total returns zero/no measurable capability.
Converts MetricResult list to name:value dict.
Simulator connects Environment->Omega->CTC Controller->C_rev->mathcal G->metrics and asks whether CTC adaptation beats ordinary optimization.
Tracks timestep, capability, independent AdaptiveMechanismSpace object and history list.
Stores environment and agent and initializes SimulationState.
Stores previous state mechanism_space, extracts constraint, calls agent.adapt, advances environment, then expects result.capability/result.mechanisms, computes expansion and appends dict history.
Calls step repeatedly, collects returned result objects in results and returns that list.
Computes treatment-state permeability; uses last mechanism_expansion history value as growth; synthesizes after_removal as 0.5*capability and dependency inputs .5/.5; combines into ctc_score.
Runs baseline then permeability simulator for same step count and returns BenchmarkResult objects from evaluate_agent.
Creates two simulators from supplied baseline/CTC agents and same supplied environment object and delegates to run_comparison.
Test file explicitly says tests do not prove CTC true; they test whether implementation represents E* rightsquigarrow C_rev hypothesis.
Test subclass of AdaptiveAgent expects self.capability, self.mechanisms and self.result and returns capability+1 with unchanged mechanisms.
Test subclass expects self.mechanisms.expand(omega) returning updated mechanism space, self.capability/self.result, and arithmetic capability+1+omega.
Construct Environment(difficulty=10), compare closed/permeable adapt results and assert permeable_result.mechanisms.size >= closed_result.mechanisms.size.
Create AdaptiveMechanismSpace, treat size as attribute, call updated=expand(omega), then assert updated.size > initial_size.
Construct shared Environment(difficulty=10), run comparison for 20 steps, assert final composite permeability metric >= closed metric.
Run closed simulator 10 steps and assert final simulator mechanism-space size equals agent mechanisms size, using size as attribute.
Construct Environment(difficulty=20), PermeableAgent, compare agent.mechanisms.size before/after adapt and assert increase.
